name: BASELINE_ADMITTED
entry_rule: clean immutable commit and selected-source manifest
exit_rule: intrinsic clean-room validation starts from exact tree
permitted_work: static validation gate harnesses and all product implementation

name: STATIC_FREEZE_ACCEPTED
exit_rule: all intrinsic schema API SQL authority and link checks pass
permitted_work: all bounded implementation and integration behind frozen contracts

name: IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZED
entry_rule: static freeze plus exact target-engine local smoke
exit_rule: authorization remains unless architecture is formally revoked
permitted_work: complete production implementation integration and qualification work
prohibited_claim: pilot GA or uncertified sensor/provider claims

name: INTERNAL_INTEGRATION_READY
entry_rule: implemented ingest-to-UI candidate and representative coherent runtime
exit_rule: end-to-end functional failure security and restore integration pass
permitted_work: complete implementation internal demonstrations and pre-pilot qualification

name: CONTROLLED_PILOT_READY
entry_rule: internal integration plus applicable live security operational and migration-independent gates
exit_rule: selected tenant cohort and rollback rehearsal accepted
permitted_work: complete implementation and approved limited pilot under declared constraints

name: GA_READY
entry_rule: all applicable LG security operational and release gates pass
prohibited_claim: defect-free or behavior outside tested boundary
